sessionSecurity.title: Session Security
sessionSecurity.description: Manage token lifetimes, idle timeout, and remember me behavior.
sessionSecurity.futureNote: These settings will take effect in upcoming session security enhancements.

sessionDurationMinutes.label: Session duration
sessionDurationMinutes.description: Defines the shared duration used for the access token and idle timeout.

accessTokenMinutes.label: Access token duration
accessTokenMinutes.description: Defines how many minutes the short-lived access token remains valid.

idleTimeoutMinutes.label: Idle timeout
idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Defines how many minutes of inactivity before the session ends.

idleWarningSeconds.label: Session warning duration
idleWarningSeconds.description: Defines how many seconds before session end the user is warned.

sessionRefreshTokenHours.label: Browser session refresh token duration
sessionRefreshTokenHours.description: Defines how many hours the refresh token is valid when remember me is not selected.

rememberMeRefreshTokenDays.label: Remember me refresh token duration
rememberMeRefreshTokenDays.description: Defines how many days the refresh token is valid when remember me is selected.

rememberMeEnabled.label: Remember me option
rememberMeEnabled.description: Allows the remember me option to be used on the login screen.
